strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Executes 8 dependent all_reduce operations sequentially with interleaved local scaling/descaling operations as shown in the reference. Each iteration performs one all_reduce dispatch followed by local element-wise operations. Total 8 all_reduce dispatches with no opportunity for overlap, representing the straightforward implementation with maximum dispatch count but simplest logic.

strategies.name: Fused Local Operations Between Collectives
strategies.desc: Merges all local scaling, division, and buffer operations between consecutive all_reduce calls into single vectorized kernels to minimize local dispatch overhead. Still performs 8 all_reduce dispatches but reduces local operation dispatches from ~32 (clone + scale + descale per iteration) to 8 fused kernels. Trades code complexity for reduced local-op dispatch count while maintaining identical collective communication pattern.

strategies.name: Two-Phase Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replaces each all_reduce with a reduce_scatter followed by all_gather pattern, enabling per-rank computation on smaller chunks between phases. For each of 8 iterations: reduce_scatter (partial sums), local scale on 1/W of data, all_gather (broadcast scaled results). Total 16 dispatches (8×2) but each operates on reduced payload initially, potentially better bandwidth utilization on large world_size.

strategies.name: Pipelined All-Reduce with Pre-Scaled Buffers
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all 8 scaling/descaling patterns into separate buffers before any collective, then pipelines all_reduce operations on transformed views. Launches multiple non-blocking all_reduce calls with different buffer offsets/strides if supported, or batches operations to overlap computation and communication. Aims for ~8 all_reduce dispatches with maximal pipeline fill, trading memory footprint for latency hiding.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Aggregation
strategies.desc:
Exploits potential node-level topology by decomposing each all_reduce into intra-node reduce + inter-node all_reduce + intra-node broadcast for the 8 iterations. With num_nodes parameter available, performs local aggregation first (cheaper), global sync across node leaders, then local distribution. Total ~24 collective dispatches (8×3 phases) but with smaller participant counts per phase, optimizing for hierarchical network topology.
